TAMIL NIFTY ANALYSIS analysis on Nifty அசையவே மாட்டேங்குது!! குட்டி குட்டி Candles எதை உணர்த்துகிறது!! Weekly closing என்ன சொல்லுது!! [Video ID: NyZ1HfeTeQY]
Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NyZ1HfeTeQY
Single Thesis: MYTH: Small candlestick patterns on a price chart serve as a reliable predictive indicator for future market direction. TRUTH: Small candles represent market indecision or low volatility, which provide no predictive certainty and are often noise rather than precursors to a specific trend breakout.

TAMIL NIFTY ANALYSIS analysis on Nifty Downtrend ஆகாமல் காக்கும் காவலன் Closing Auction Session -13-Aug-2026 [Video ID: zkSM_SN6amk]
Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zkSM_SN6amk
Single Thesis: MYTH: The Closing Auction Session acts as a protective mechanism that prevents the Nifty from entering a downtrend. TRUTH: The Closing Auction Session is merely a liquidity mechanism designed to determine a single closing price based on order imbalances and does not possess the predictive power or structural influence to reverse or prevent broader market downtrends.

TAMIL NIFTY ANALYSIS analysis on Nifty 24500 கீழே Closing - Downtrend ஆகுமா? Important Price Action - 12-Aug-2026 [Video ID: ZLTuTSC-KRU]
Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZLTuTSC-KRU
Single Thesis: MYTH: A specific price level (like Nifty 24500) acts as an inherent, mechanical trigger that dictates the start of a long-term market downtrend. TRUTH: Technical levels are merely historical reference points that lack predictive power, as market trends are fundamentally driven by macroeconomic data, geopolitical events, and institutional liquidity rather than simple price crossovers.

TAMIL NIFTY ANALYSIS analysis on Nifty waiting for Breakout - அமைதியோ அமைதி!! BSE Focus பண்ணலாமா? 11-Aug-2026 [Video ID: x6ossnCbGEw]

Single Thesis: MYTH: Trading success and market navigation can be guaranteed or simplified by following specific 'price action' workshops or authorized broker guidance. TRUTH: Financial markets are inherently unpredictable, and no educational workshop or broker affiliation can eliminate the systematic risk or guarantee profitable outcomes for traders.

ZERO1 BY ZERODHA analysis on I investigated India's biggest Online Sale! [Video ID: 2bfv5kp2dAM]

Single Thesis: MYTH: Online sales are designed to provide consumers with the best possible value for their purchases. TRUTH: E-commerce platforms utilize sophisticated dark patterns to manipulate consumer psychology and create artificial urgency, forcing impulsive spending rather than genuine savings.

ZERO1 BY ZERODHA analysis on Petrol vs EV: Which Car Is Actually Cheaper After 5 Years?😱 [Video ID: OzbTTToLnYo]
Link: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/OzbTTToLnYo
Single Thesis: MYTH: Electric vehicles are always the cheaper financial choice over petrol cars regardless of usage patterns. TRUTH: The financial viability of an EV depends heavily on specific variables like driving distance, local tax structures, and the significant uncertainty surrounding long-term battery degradation and resale value.

MONEY PECHU analysis on TMCV Vs TMPV -  TMCV secret என்ன? [Video ID: JGCsRO8OGyE]
Link: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/JGCsRO8OGyE
Single Thesis: MYTH: Investors can accurately time the market to identify the precise 'lunch time' to exit or re-enter specific volatile stocks like Tata Consumer Products or Varun Beverages. TRUTH: Market timing is notoriously unreliable, and attempting to predict short-term price bottoms often leads to missed gains or increased losses compared to a consistent long-term investment strategy.

MONEY PECHU analysis on தங்கம் விலை திரும்ப குறையாதா?  இதுதான் நல்ல Opportunity-ஆ? | Natco | Tata Motors | Mahindra | IDFC | [Video ID: 1r8izQXljYM]

Single Thesis: MYTH: Gold prices are guaranteed to fall back to lower levels, making current market highs an inherently bad time for new investments. TRUTH: Gold prices are driven by complex global macroeconomic factors and central bank policies rather than a predictable reversion to mean, meaning current prices reflect a new baseline rather than a temporary anomaly.

ZERO1 BY ZERODHA analysis on 90% of Indians don't know this about Mutual funds [Video ID: PsOdPvQX6v0]
Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PsOdPvQX6v0
Single Thesis: MYTH: The most important factor to consider when choosing a mutual fund is its past returns. TRUTH: Past returns are secondary to risk-adjusted metrics like standard deviation and beta, which reveal the volatility and risk-taking behavior required to achieve those returns.

ZERO1 BY ZERODHA analysis on The REAL Cost of Buying a ₹17 Lakh Car🚗💸 [Video ID: YtVQ1RNyFFs]
Link: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/YtVQ1RNyFFs
Single Thesis: MYTH: The affordability of a car can be determined solely by comparing its purchase price or monthly EMI to one's monthly income. TRUTH: The true cost of car ownership must include hidden recurring expenses like fuel, insurance, and maintenance, which often significantly inflate the monthly financial burden beyond just the loan repayment.

ZERO1 BY ZERODHA analysis on 5 Dirty Tricks E-Commerce Uses to Make You Spend More [Video ID: WLWpANRoeBU]
Link: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/WLWpANRoeBU
Single Thesis: MYTH: A discount is always a genuine reduction from a product's established market value. TRUTH: Retailers frequently inflate original prices before a sale to create the false illusion of savings, meaning the 'discounted' price is often the product's standard market rate.

ZERO1 BY ZERODHA analysis on India’s Energy Sector Is Growing Fast. Should You Invest?🤔 [Video ID: OKd8suGj-tE]
Link: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/OKd8suGj-tE
Single Thesis: MYTH: High renewable energy capacity automatically equates to a successful clean energy transition. TRUTH: Rapid renewable growth is currently undermined by inadequate transmission infrastructure and persistent reliance on fossil fuels, rendering installed capacity an incomplete metric for actual energy delivery.

ZERO1 BY ZERODHA analysis on SWP Explained: How One Mistake Can Drain Your Money 💸 [Video ID: mVnBBGG2Nrc]
Link: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/mVnBBGG2Nrc
Single Thesis: MYTH: A Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP) provides a guaranteed, safe stream of monthly income throughout retirement regardless of withdrawal rates. TRUTH: An SWP is not a fixed annuity; if the withdrawal rate exceeds the portfolio's growth rate, especially during periods of high inflation or market volatility, the underlying corpus will be prematurely exhausted.
